description: Fork of exp654 (no resid, dense out_proj). Alternative design to exp655's sparse_scatter: 2-headed out_proj. n_heads=2, n_out per head = E//2 = 192, tph=256 per head. Total tables 2*256=512 (matches exp655). Total weights 2*256*64*192=6,291,456/layer = 37.75M (matches exp655). Bandwidth 2*256*192=98,304 writes/token (matches exp655). The two heads' outputs concatenate to E=384 (disjoint halves). Direct head-to-head with exp655 (sparse_scatter w/ overlapping output writes). Reference: exp654 = 1.4919 (dense), exp655 (sparse_scatter 1/2, 77.07M) ~1.49 projected, exp650 = 1.4825 (with resid), vanilla SOTA exp328 = 1.3882.
